scenarios.scenario_abstract: On a cool cloudy day, [X] draws on limited styling experience to compare a T-shirt, crewneck sweatshirt, and hoodie beneath an owned thin black bomber jacket, checking how each neck shape affects warmth, face framing, collar bunching, hood bulk, and comfort when the bomber is zipped, opened, or removed.
examples: keeping a simple crew opening clear of the bomber collar
checking whether an attached hood bunches behind the neck under the exact jacket
opening the bomber indoors without leaving an awkward or overly warm upper edge
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在凉爽多云的一天，[X]虽然不太懂穿搭，仍会围绕已有的偏薄黑色飞行夹克比较 T 恤、圆领卫衣和连帽上衣，检查不同领型对保暖、脸部衬托、领口堆叠、帽子体积，以及夹克拉上、敞开或脱下后的舒适度有何影响。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a casual optometrist visit at about 1 C to try luxury frames, [X] chooses a polished warm top layer whose neckline keeps the face clear, comparing a neat knit, turtleneck, and coat combination by neck coverage, indoor heat, bulk near the temples and jaw, and how cleanly different frames can be put on and viewed.
examples: using a raised knit edge for the cold trip without crowding the frames indoors
keeping the face unobstructed while several glasses are taken on and off
balancing a polished neckline with the heavier coat chosen for the weather
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在约 1 摄氏度的天气里去验光店试戴奢华镜框时，[X]会选择既保暖又利落的上装组合，并比较整洁针织上衣、高领上衣与外套搭配在颈部覆盖、室内积热、太阳穴和下颌附近的体积，以及反复摘戴和观察不同镜框时是否能让脸部保持清晰。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: When turning a garment imagined in the mind into a sketch, paper pattern, and muslin, [X] narrows the first project toward a simple top and tests the planned neckline for head entry, face framing, seam stability, shape retention, dressing order, and compatibility with the intended sleeves and silhouette before cutting final fabric.
examples: drawing several opening shapes before committing the paper pattern
checking in muslin that a close raised edge still passes comfortably over the head
revising a structured collar or hood whose weight distorts the unfinished top
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 把脑中的服装形象转成草图、纸样和坯布样衣时，[X]会把首个项目收敛到简单上装；在裁剪正式面料前，测试目标领型是否便于套头、能否衬托脸部、接缝是否稳定、形状能否保持、穿脱顺序是否顺畅，以及是否与袖子和整体廓形协调。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For an R&B stadium concert, [X] builds a comfortable elevated-streetwear outfit for stairs, dense crowds, dancing, cooling down, and a late return, comparing a breathable base and removable overshirt, flannel, bomber, or hoodie by neck ventilation, collar overlap, hood bulk, and comfort through repeated layer changes.
examples: keeping the base opening comfortable while dancing in a warm crowd
wearing an overshirt open without its collar competing with the layer below
removing or tying an outer layer without leaving a bulky hood at the neck
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为了参加 R&B 体育场演唱会，[X]会准备一套适合走台阶、挤在人群中站立、跳舞、散热和夜间返程的舒适精致街头装，并比较透气打底与可脱下的罩衫、法兰绒衬衫、飞行夹克或连帽层在颈部通风、衣领重叠、帽子体积和反复增减衣物时的舒适度。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a formal wedding in an army-green suit, [X] coordinates the upper-body pieces and compares shirt collars and neck openings by how they support a tie or bow tie, sit beneath the suit lapels, remain neat through the ceremony and photographs, and match the couple's chosen dress code.
examples: choosing a structured shirt collar that holds the selected neckwear in place
checking that the collar points and suit lapels do not overlap awkwardly
keeping the same neckline visually consistent across the groomsmen photographs
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 穿军绿色西装参加正式婚礼时，[X]会协调上身单品，比较衬衫衣领和领口能否支撑领带或领结、是否能平整地置于西装翻领之下、能否在仪式和合影中保持整洁，以及是否符合新人确定的统一着装要求。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While studying engineering in Egypt, [X] chooses everyday campus tops for classes, study groups, club meetings, seminars, and career events, comparing necklines by socially comfortable coverage, long-day practicality, and the ability to shift from casual peer interaction to a more formal college setting without feeling conspicuous or overdressed.
examples: using a modest open or round shape for ordinary classes
adding a softly structured collar when a seminar calls for more formality
choosing raised coverage that remains comfortable during extended indoor work
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在埃及工科学院就读时，[X]会为课程、自习小组、社团活动、研讨会和招聘活动选择日常上装，比较不同领型能否提供让自己和周围人都舒适的覆盖、能否适应漫长的一天，以及能否从同学间的休闲交流过渡到较正式的校园场合而不显突兀或过度隆重。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After noticing rapid facial redness on sunny days, [X] adds a lightweight sun top to shade, a wide-brimmed hat, cooling water, and trigger avoidance, comparing a high collar, attached hood, and open neckline by neck and lower-face coverage, heat buildup, sweat, skin contact, and tolerance during repeated outings.
examples: raising coverage around the side of the neck without blocking head movement
using a hood with the hat only when the two do not trap excessive heat
comparing redness and comfort on otherwise similar sunny outings
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 发现晴天外出时脸部很快发红后，[X]会把轻薄防晒上装加入遮阴、宽檐帽、冷水降温和避开诱因的方案，并比较高领、连帽和较开放领口在颈部与下脸覆盖、积热、出汗、贴肤摩擦以及反复外出时是否仍能耐受方面的差异。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a two-week solo September trip through Seoul, Gyeongju, Busan, and Jeju, [X] packs a small rotation of short- and long-sleeve tops for warm walks, traditional stops, cool evenings, island wind, and light outer layers, comparing necklines by modest coverage, ventilation, face framing, and tidiness through repeated layering.
examples: using a higher but breathable edge at a traditional stop
leaving enough ventilation for a warm day of city walking
keeping a hood or collar from bunching beneath a wind layer on Jeju
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 九月在首尔、庆州、釜山和济州独自旅行两周时，[X]会准备少量短袖与长袖上装，以应对温暖步行、传统场所、凉爽夜晚、海岛风和轻薄外层，并比较不同领型在得体覆盖、通风、脸部衬托以及反复叠穿时衣领或帽子能否保持整洁方面的表现。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For an April Sri Lanka route combining hot cultural sites, temple visits requiring covered shoulders, active outdoor stops, and cold Nuwara Eliya evenings, [X] packs a compact top rotation and compares simple, structured, and raised necklines by respectful coverage, heat release, rewear comfort, and fit beneath one sweater or light jacket.
examples: keeping a daytime opening modest enough for a temple visit
using a higher neckline for a chilly highland morning
avoiding doubled collars when the limited warm layer is added
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为四月的斯里兰卡行程准备精简上装轮换时，[X]需要应对炎热文化景点、要求遮住肩膀的寺庙、户外活动和努沃勒埃利耶的寒冷夜晚，并比较简洁、结构化和较高领型在得体覆盖、散热、重复穿着舒适度以及穿在唯一一件毛衣或轻夹克下时的适配性。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a casual afternoon campus reunion, [X] compares a sweater with dark jeans against a polo or T-shirt under an overshirt, choosing a neckline that feels relaxed but intentional, frames the face in group photos, stays comfortable through conversation, and looks tidy if the outer layer is removed.
examples: using a clean crew opening to keep the sweater casual but put-together
adding a collar when the reunion may be slightly dressier than an ordinary campus day
checking that an open overshirt leaves the base neckline visually balanced
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 参加下午的校园同学聚会时，[X]会在毛衣配深色牛仔裤、Polo 衫，以及 T 恤外搭罩衫之间比较，选择既放松又显得用心、能在合影中衬托脸部、长时间交谈仍舒适，并在脱下外层后依然整洁的领型。

professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract: A theme-park historical-photo business assembles quick-change costumes for visitors with varied modern sizes and comfort limits, using reusable tops and detachable collars, cuffs, bow ties, or simple neck pieces to signal different periods and roles while keeping dressing fast, wigs and makeup optional, and the finished portrait visually coherent.
examples: swapping a detachable high collar to change the apparent period without replacing the whole costume
using a simpler opening for a visitor who declines a wig or elaborate accessories
checking that a structured neck piece stays aligned during a short seated photo session
professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 一家主题公园历史照相馆为不同现代尺码和舒适需求的游客准备快速换装服饰，通过可重复使用的上装与可拆卸衣领、袖口、领结或简洁领饰表现不同年代和角色，同时要求换装迅速、假发和化妆可选，并让最终照片保持完整可信。

professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract: On a first shift delivering food by bicycle, a new courier uses adjustable upper layers while repeatedly riding, stopping, checking traffic, looking over the shoulder, cooling down, and protecting a phone inside the jacket, comparing necklines by head-turn clearance, wind exposure, sweat, collar pressure, and whether an attached hood can be secured safely.
examples: turning fully for a traffic check without a raised edge rubbing the jaw
opening the neck area during a stop without exposing loose fabric to the ride
securing an attached hood so it does not flap or interfere with hearing
professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在第一次骑自行车送餐的班次中，新骑手使用可调节的上身分层，并反复骑行、停车、观察交通、回头确认、降温和把手机放在夹克内侧；他会比较不同领型对转头空间、迎风、出汗、衣领压迫，以及连帽能否安全固定的影响。
